summary: The root كنن primarily means to cover, conceal, or protect something, often by putting it into a shelter or hidden place.

provenance.lane: Edward William Lane, An Arabic-English Lexicon (1863-93), public domain. Digital text via Perseus, Tufts University, CC BY-SA 3.0 US.

headwords.gloss: A place of retreat; concealment; shelter

parts.t: such as a cave, and an excavated house or chamber: (Beyd, xvi. 83:) see
A thing that serves for veiling, covering,
, where I have thus rendered it.

headwords.def: كِنٌّ A place of retreat or concealment; such as a cave, and an excavated house or chamber: (Beyd, xvi. 83:) see بَرٌّ . كِنٌّ The shelter of a wall: see دِفْءٌ . A thing that serves for veiling, covering, or protecting. (S, * Msb, * K.) See ظِلٌّ , where I have thus rendered it.

headwords.gloss: A fire-place; a place in which fire is lighted

parts.t: A fire-place; a place in which fire is lighted.

headwords.def: كَانُونٌ A fire-place; a place in which fire is lighted. (S, K.)

parts.t: : see a verse of El-Aashà in art.

headwords.def: مَكْنُونُ الفَائِلِ : see a verse of El-Aashà in art. فيل .

headword_note: Lane indexes geminate roots with two letters where the Corpus uses three; both spellings are resolved here.
